question.:question/problem:
Find the antiderivative of
$-\frac{6}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}+\frac{1}{x^{5}}+3x^{7}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(-\frac{6}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}+\frac{1}{x^{5}}+3x^{7}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(-6x^{\frac{-8}{7}}+x^{-5}+3x^{7}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -6\int x^{\frac{-8}{7}}\,\mathrm{d}x+\int x^{-5}\,\mathrm{d}x+3\int x^{7}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -6\left(\frac{x^{\frac{-8}{7}+1}}{(\frac{-8}{7}+1)}\right)+\left(\frac{x^{-5+1}}{(-5+1)}\right)\\ &\quad +3\left(\frac{x^{7+1}}{(7+1)}\right)+C\\ &= \frac{42}{\sqrt[7]{x}}-\frac{1}{4x^{4}}+\frac{3x^{8}}{8}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Find the antiderivative of
$-3x^{3}-\frac{4}{x^{6}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{x^{6}}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(-3x^{3}-\frac{4}{x^{6}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{x^{6}}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(-3x^{3}-4x^{-6}+x^{\frac{-6}{5}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -3\int x^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x-4\int x^{-6}\,\mathrm{d}x+\int x^{\frac{-6}{5}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -3\left(\frac{x^{3+1}}{(3+1)}\right)-4\left(\frac{x^{-6+1}}{(-6+1)}\right)\\ &\quad +\left(\frac{x^{\frac{-6}{5}+1}}{(\frac{-6}{5}+1)}\right)+C\\ &= -\frac{3x^{4}}{4}+\frac{4}{5x^{5}}-\frac{5}{\sqrt[5]{x}}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Find the antiderivative of
$\frac{5}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}-\frac{4}{x^{2}}+4x^{4}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(\frac{5}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}-\frac{4}{x^{2}}+4x^{4}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(5x^{\frac{-8}{7}}-4x^{-2}+4x^{4}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 5\int x^{\frac{-8}{7}}\,\mathrm{d}x-4\int x^{-2}\,\mathrm{d}x+4\int x^{4}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 5\left(\frac{x^{\frac{-8}{7}+1}}{(\frac{-8}{7}+1)}\right)-4\left(\frac{x^{-2+1}}{(-2+1)}\right)\\ &\quad +4\left(\frac{x^{4+1}}{(4+1)}\right)+C\\ &= -\frac{35}{\sqrt[7]{x}}+\frac{4}{x}+\frac{4x^{5}}{5}+C.\end{aligned}

question.:question/problem:
Find the antiderivative of
$2x^{5}+\frac{1}{x^{4}}-\frac{6}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(2x^{5}+\frac{1}{x^{4}}-\frac{6}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(2x^{5}+x^{-4}-6x^{\frac{-8}{7}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 2\int x^{5}\,\mathrm{d}x+\int x^{-4}\,\mathrm{d}x-6\int x^{\frac{-8}{7}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 2\left(\frac{x^{5+1}}{(5+1)}\right)+\left(\frac{x^{-4+1}}{(-4+1)}\right)\\ &\quad -6\left(\frac{x^{\frac{-8}{7}+1}}{(\frac{-8}{7}+1)}\right)+C\\ &= \frac{x^{6}}{3}-\frac{1}{3x^{3}}+\frac{42}{\sqrt[7]{x}}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

$\frac{6}{x^{2}}+6x^{3}+4\sqrt[3]{x^{2}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.

Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(\frac{6}{x^{2}}+6x^{3}+4\sqrt[3]{x^{2}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(6x^{-2}+6x^{3}+4x^{\frac{2}{3}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 6\int x^{-2}\,\mathrm{d}x+6\int x^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x+4\int x^{\frac{2}{3}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 6\left(\frac{x^{-2+1}}{(-2+1)}\right)+6\left(\frac{x^{3+1}}{(3+1)}\right)\\ &\quad +4\left(\frac{x^{\frac{2}{3}+1}}{(\frac{2}{3}+1)}\right)+C\\ &= -\frac{6}{x}+\frac{3x^{4}}{2}+\frac{12\sqrt[3]{x^{5}}}{5}+C.\end{aligned}

question.:question/problem:

$-\frac{5}{x^{3}}-4\sqrt[5]{x}-5x^{5}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(-\frac{5}{x^{3}}-4\sqrt[5]{x}-5x^{5}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(-5x^{-3}-4x^{\frac{1}{5}}-5x^{5}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -5\int x^{-3}\,\mathrm{d}x-4\int x^{\frac{1}{5}}\,\mathrm{d}x-5\int x^{5}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -5\left(\frac{x^{-3+1}}{(-3+1)}\right)-4\left(\frac{x^{\frac{1}{5}+1}}{(\frac{1}{5}+1)}\right)\\ &\quad -5\left(\frac{x^{5+1}}{(5+1)}\right)+C\\ &= \frac{5}{2x^{2}}-\frac{10\sqrt[5]{x^{6}}}{3}-\frac{5x^{6}}{6}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

$-5x^{5}-4\sqrt[5]{x}-\frac{5}{x^{3}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(-5x^{5}-4\sqrt[5]{x}-\frac{5}{x^{3}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(-5x^{5}-4x^{\frac{1}{5}}-5x^{-3}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -5\int x^{5}\,\mathrm{d}x-4\int x^{\frac{1}{5}}\,\mathrm{d}x-5\int x^{-3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -5\left(\frac{x^{5+1}}{(5+1)}\right)-4\left(\frac{x^{\frac{1}{5}+1}}{(\frac{1}{5}+1)}\right)\\ &\quad -5\left(\frac{x^{-3+1}}{(-3+1)}\right)+C\\ &= -\frac{5x^{6}}{6}-\frac{10\sqrt[5]{x^{6}}}{3}+\frac{5}{2x^{2}}+C.\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(-\frac{6}{x^{6}}+6x^{7}-\frac{6}{\sqrt[3]{x^{4}}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(-6x^{-6}+6x^{7}-6x^{\frac{-4}{3}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -6\int x^{-6}\,\mathrm{d}x+6\int x^{7}\,\mathrm{d}x-6\int x^{\frac{-4}{3}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -6\left(\frac{x^{-6+1}}{(-6+1)}\right)+6\left(\frac{x^{7+1}}{(7+1)}\right)\\ &\quad -6\left(\frac{x^{\frac{-4}{3}+1}}{(\frac{-4}{3}+1)}\right)+C\\ &= \frac{6}{5x^{5}}+\frac{3x^{8}}{4}+\frac{18}{\sqrt[3]{x}}+C.\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(x^{2}-\sqrt{x}+2\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(x^{2}-x^{\frac{1}{2}}+2\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int x^{2}\,\mathrm{d}x-\int x^{\frac{1}{2}}\,\mathrm{d}x+2\int 1\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \left(\frac{x^{2+1}}{(2+1)}\right)-\left(\frac{x^{\frac{1}{2}+1}}{(\frac{1}{2}+1)}\right)\\ &\quad +2\left(\frac{x^{0+1}}{(0+1)}\right)+C\\ &= \frac{x^{3}}{3}-\frac{2\sqrt{x^{3}}}{3}+2x+C.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(4x^{7}+\sqrt[5]{x}-\frac{1}{\sqrt[7]{x^{13}}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(4x^{7}+x^{\frac{1}{5}}-x^{\frac{-13}{7}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 4\int x^{7}\,\mathrm{d}x+\int x^{\frac{1}{5}}\,\mathrm{d}x-\int x^{\frac{-13}{7}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 4\left(\frac{x^{7+1}}{(7+1)}\right)+\left(\frac{x^{\frac{1}{5}+1}}{(\frac{1}{5}+1)}\right)\\ &\quad -\left(\frac{x^{\frac{-13}{7}+1}}{(\frac{-13}{7}+1)}\right)+C\\ &= \frac{x^{8}}{2}+\frac{5\sqrt[5]{x^{6}}}{6}+\frac{7}{6\sqrt[7]{x^{6}}}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int (\sqrt[5]{{x}^{4}}-x+\frac{2}{{x}^{4}})\,\text{d}x\\ &= \int {x}^{4/5}\,\text{d}x-\int x\,\text{d}x+2\int {x}^{-4}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{4/5+1}}{(\frac{4}{5}+1)}-\frac{{x}^{1+1}}{(1+1)}+2\cdot \frac{{x}^{-4+1}}{(-4+1)}+C \\  & =\frac{{x}^{9/5}}{\left(\frac{9}{5}\right)}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+2\cdot \frac{{x}^{-3}}{(-3)}+C \\  & =\frac{5\sqrt[5]{{x}^{9}}}{9}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}-\frac{2}{3{x}^{3}}+C.\end{aligned}
$$
